summary: Implementation plan for AuditSphere (STE Audit Management Platform v2.2), an enterprise audit execution workstation complying with ISA/IFRS standards in Qatari Riyal (QAR). Covers the 7-phase Karbon-inspired engagement lifecycle, 9 core functional screens, dual-key onboarding gatekeeper, 3-tier materiality calculator, split P&L / Balance Sheet fieldwork workspace with substantive testing drawers, manager review notes and confirmations blocker, ISA 700/705 partner opinion station, 5-part deliverables bundle, 60-day ISA 230 regulatory file lock countdown, isolated client PBC portal, and firm practice management ledger.
